description: This file is a Go source file implementing a test helper library for the Mattermost server, providing setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing components such as database stores, search engines, and resource management.

classes.name: MainHelper
classes.description: A helper class for setting up and managing test environment components such as database connections, search engine, and resources.

classes.name: HelperOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for MainHelper, including enabling store, resources, and parallel test execution.

methods.name: NewMainHelper
methods.description: Creates a new MainHelper instance with default options, initializing environment variables and logging.

methods.name: NewMainHelperWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a new MainHelper instance with specified options, setting up environment, logging, and optional store and resources.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Runs the main test suite, managing working directory and logger shutdown.

methods.name: GetNewStores
methods.description: Provides new store, SQL store, settings, and search engine instances for tests.

methods.name: setupStore
methods.description: Initializes the store, SQL store, and search engine components.

methods.name: ToggleReplicasOff
methods.description: Disables data source replicas in the SQL store.

methods.name: ToggleReplicasOn
methods.description: Enables data source replicas in the SQL store.

methods.name: PreloadMigrations
methods.description: Preloads database migrations to optimize startup.

methods.name: PreloadMigrations
methods.description: Wrapper to preload migrations using current settings.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes database connections, and exits.

methods.name: Parallel
methods.description: Runs the test in parallel if enabled in options.
